lyrics:
[verse]
Bruno heard hold your horses, so
He chased them down the road, let's go!
Kiki laughed, oh Bruno, whoa,
It just means wait and take it slow!
[chorus]
Hold your horses, hold your horses,
Slow it down, no racing forces!
Hold your horses, hold your horses,
Patience wins the gentle courses!
[verse]
Long ago with reins in hand,
You'd hold the horses, make them stand,
So now it means just wait a beat,
Don't rush ahead on hurried feet!
[chorus]
Hold your horses, hold your horses,
Slow it down, no racing forces!
Hold your horses, hold your horses,
Count to three, no reckless forces!
[outro]
So when you're rushing, quick and strong,
Slow it down and sing along!
